title: Tech Note: Operations on Arrays and Selections

historical_commentary.text: This note teaches how to treat named selections with set-like operations (union, intersection, difference) via custom methods, extending 4D's classic procedural record-set model that predates 4D's native SQL engine (v11 SQL, ~2007) and later ORDA collection-based data access. The underlying concepts of combining and manipulating record sets remain fully relevant in modern 4D, but the specific technique of hand-writing custom commands to bridge sets and named selections is largely superseded by more direct, built-in language support for selection/entity-set operations introduced in later 4D versions.
related_updates: 4D's language has since added more built-in commands and set operators for combining and manipulating selections directly, reducing the need for custom bridging methods like those in this note
ORDA (introduced 4D v16, 2018) introduced entity selections as a more modern, object-oriented alternative to sets and named selections for combining and querying record subsets
